what: Edge depth (FwDET) vs the official depth class in Seoul, by DEM
method: Points inside the 100-year national-river extent; edge depth = median DEM elevation of the flood edge within 500 m minus ground at the point; share of points inside the class band; class medians.

glo30_seoul_han_193pts.note: up to 21 m in a 2-5 m class (surface model reads building tops)

decision: Main method = official class band; edge depth = diagnostic sub check (PR #56).
licence: Summary statistics only; no polygon, clip or raster derived from the maps is stored.
